category_definitions.confirmed_incident: confirmation_level == 'confirmed_incident'. None are created by replay, grouping, or the demo walkthrough.
category_definitions.exploratory_monitoring_signal: scientific_classification == 'exploratory_zero_mad_signal' or ordinary_warning_eligible is false. Shown separately and never counted as an ordinary warning, even when confirmation_level is 'preliminary_warning'.
category_definitions.corroborated_warning: confirmation_level == 'corroborated_warning'. Ordinary warning with supporting evidence; not a confirmed incident.
category_definitions.ordinary_preliminary_warning: confirmation_level == 'preliminary_warning' and not exploratory. Ordinary unconfirmed warning.
category_definitions.unclassified_record: Any record that matches none of the rules above; display as unavailable, do not count as a warning.

dq.explanation: ملاحظة جودة بيانات فقط؛ مفيش prediction أو incident claim للطاقة/المباني.

rule_definitions.negative_reading: kwh < 0. Metered consumption cannot be negative.
rule_definitions.negative_magnitude_near_meter_median: Subset of negative_reading whose magnitude is within the configured band of the meter's own median; consistent with a sign inversion, not proof of one.
rule_definitions.unit_scale_spike: A single reading above spike_multiple_of_meter_median x the meter's own median of non-negative readings; consistent with a unit or scale error on that reading.
rule_definitions.meter_unit_scale_mismatch: The meter's own median is above meter_scale_ratio_to_peer_median x the median of all meter medians; the whole series is on a different scale (for example Wh instead of kWh).
rule_definitions.flatline_run: At least flatline_min_consecutive_readings consecutive identical non-missing readings.

summary.evaluation_basis: Retrospective audit of the full replay period. Reference medians use each meter's own non-negative readings; no future-dated warning is issued from this audit.
notes: Findings are data-quality observations, not electrical faults, outages, or theft.
missing_reading alone does not make a meter appear in meter_findings.
